image_description: A colorful minibus (likely a converted van chassis) parked on a paved surface. The vehicle features a two-tone paint job with a red roof and upper section, and a lime green lower body separated by a yellow stripe. It has a prominent front grille, large windshield, side windows, and visible wheels. There is text on the windshield and license plate area.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, single-pane windshield is visible at the front, and multiple side windows are clearly defined along the passenger cabin.

The side profile shows the characteristic seam and handle of a sliding passenger door.
The short hood and grille placement indicate a front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame; only the front three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
